prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
competitors_mentioned: Illinois State Bar Association’s Lawyer Referral Service
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” attorney for every car accident claim. For a **serious injury, disputed liability, or potentially high-value case**, **Corboy & Demetrio** is one prominent Chicago firm to consider; it reports decades of plaintiff-side experience and a substantial record of verdicts and settlements. **Phillips Law Offices** is another established option, with car-accident experience and trial-lawyer credentials.

Those are starting points, not independent endorsements—the firms’ results and awards are largely self-reported, and past outcomes don’t predict yours. Speak with two or three lawyers before choosing. Ask who will personally handle your case, their experience with similar crashes, how fees and case expenses work, and whether they recommend negotiating or preparing for trial. Many injury firms offer free consultations and work on contingency, but confirm the written fee agreement.

You can also request a referral through the **Illinois State Bar Association’s Lawyer Referral Service**. If you share whether the crash involved serious injuries, disputed fault, or an uninsured driver, I can suggest what kind of attorney to prioritize.
